# Card-file debug Wi-Fi shell on stock E-M5 III 1.7

The card-file debug shell documented by Olympus firmware research also works on a stock E-M5 III.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** stock 1.7 with a card settings file

The card-file method from Olympus firmware research (documented for the PEN-F) starts the stock debug network and user shell on stock E-M5 III 1.7; nothing is flashed.

**Availability:** research. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [E-M5 III 1.7: card-file debug shell tested](../evidence/em5-iii-wifi-shell-camera.md) — physical camera; pass; partial report; not applicable.

## Limits

- Method and discovery: Olympus firmware research (oly_fw_analysis); a forum user first reported it on the E-M5 III.
- The E-M5 III camera report comes from the E-M5 III firmware notes.
- The network has no password; one shell connection per power-on.
